 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. La Cartuja Stadium hosts an emotional Andalusian derby in LaLiga between Real Betis and Málaga CF, who meet again in the top flight for the first time in eight years.
 The clash will see Manuel Pellegrini, Isco, Diego Llorente and Pablo Fornals reunited with their former club. The Green and Whites need a win to stay in the Champions League places, while coping with the absences of Cucho Hernández, Junior Firpo and Bernal. Málaga, meanwhile, arrive bottom of the table and buoyed by their cup win, but hampered by absences and desperate to secure their first league victory.
